title: Who is who in The Rattrap
back: Peddler (nameless, transformed), crofter (thirty kronor), ironmaster (mistaken identity, sheriff), Edla (one day of peace, the trust that redeems).

title: The Rattrap in six beats
back: Theory → thirty kronor → forest → Ramsjö mistake → Edla and Christmas → rattrap gift and the letter signed Captain von Stahle.

title: The world is a rattrap
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Touch the bait and the trap closes" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="80" y="60" width="160" height="90" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" rx="6"/><path d="M80,60 L240,150 M240,60 L80,150" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="105" r="14" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">riches · joys · shelter · food · heat · clothes</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Touch the bait and the trap closes</text></svg>
back: The peddler's idle theory pleases him because the world has been unkind: picturing others trapped is revenge. He tests it on himself when he takes the thirty kronor.

title: The pouch on the nail
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Porridge, tobacco, cards — then a broken pane" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="100" y="40" width="120" height="130" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.12" stroke="none" rx="4"/><path d="M100,40 H220 V170 H100 Z" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="160" cy="56" r="4" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M140,62 Q160,50 180,62 L176,110 Q160,120 144,110 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><text x="160" y="92" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none">30</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Porridge, tobacco, cards — then a broken pane</text></svg>
back: The lonely crofter showed the three ten-kronor notes to prove his cow story. Half an hour after leaving, the peddler smashed the window and took them. Hospitality repaid with theft.

title: Caught in his own trap
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Walking in circles with the stolen notes" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><path d="M50,75 L80.80000000000001,124.5 L63.2,124.5 L89.6,163.0 L55.5,163.0 V185 H44.5 V163.0 L10.399999999999999,163.0 L36.8,124.5 L19.199999999999996,124.5 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.35" stroke="none"/><path d="M110,45 L149.2,108.0 L126.8,108.0 L160.4,157.0 L117.0,157.0 V185 H103.0 V157.0 L59.6,157.0 L93.2,108.0 L70.8,108.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><path d="M180,65 L213.6,119.0 L194.4,119.0 L223.2,161.0 L186.0,161.0 V185 H174.0 V161.0 L136.8,161.0 L165.6,119.0 L146.4,119.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.4" stroke="none"/><path d="M250,35 L292.0,102.5 L268.0,102.5 L304.0,155.0 L257.5,155.0 V185 H242.5 V155.0 L196.0,155.0 L232.0,102.5 L208.0,102.5 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.55" stroke="none"/><path d="M300,85 L328.0,130.0 L312.0,130.0 L336.0,165.0 L305.0,165.0 V185 H295.0 V165.0 L264.0,165.0 L288.0,130.0 L272.0,130.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.3" stroke="none"/><g><circle cx="160" cy="131.6" r="6.6" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.95" stroke="none"/><path d="M151.0,146.2 Q160,138.2 169.0,146.2 L167.56,159.8 L169.9,185 H166.3 L160.9,167.0 L154.6,185 H150.64 L156.4,159.8 L152.44,159.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.95" stroke="none"/></g><circle cx="160" cy="60" r="10" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Walking in circles with the stolen notes</text></svg>
back: The forest becomes an impenetrable prison; he remembers his theory and knows he has let himself be fooled by a bait. The theorist of the rattrap is its victim.

title: Firelight at Ramsjö
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="'Nils Olof!' — the ironmaster sees an old comrade" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="0" y="120" width="320" height="80" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="none"/><g transform="translate(160,140) scale(1.4)"><path d="M0,0 C-22,-20 -16,-46 0,-60 C6,-40 20,-36 18,-18 C26,-30 28,-36 30,-44 C40,-26 34,-6 20,2 Q0,10 0,0 Z" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="60" cy="113.8" r="8.8" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><path d="M48.0,130.6 Q60,122.6 72.0,130.6 L70.08,151.4 L64.8,151.4 L65.76,185 H61.2 L60.48,153.0 H59.52 L58.8,185 H54.24 L55.2,151.4 L49.92,151.4 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="260" cy="96.0" r="11.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none"/><path d="M245.0,115.0 Q260,107.0 275.0,115.0 L272.6,143.0 L266.0,143.0 L267.2,185 H261.5 L260.6,145.0 H259.4 L258.5,185 H252.8 L254.0,143.0 L247.4,143.0 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none"/><path d="M243.5,90.5 H276.5 V86.1 H269.9 V74.0 H250.1 V86.1 H243.5 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">'Nils Olof!' — the ironmaster sees an old comrade</text></svg>
back: In the dim forge the ironmaster takes the ragged stranger for Captain von Stahle and invites him home. Carrying stolen money, the peddler refuses — but does not correct the mistake.

title: One day of peace
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Edla against her father at the breakfast table" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><circle cx="90" cy="87.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M73.5,107.19999999999999 Q90,99.19999999999999 106.5,107.19999999999999 L119.7,185 H60.3 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><g><circle cx="230" cy="87.1" r="12.1" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><path d="M213.5,107.19999999999999 Q230,99.19999999999999 246.5,107.19999999999999 L243.86,138.8 L236.6,138.8 L237.92,185 H231.65 L230.66,141.0 H229.34 L228.35,185 H222.08 L223.4,138.8 L216.14,138.8 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><path d="M211.85,81.05 H248.15 V76.21 H240.89 V62.89999999999999 H219.11 V76.21 H211.85 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/></g><g><rect x="60" y="20" width="200" height="44" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M82,64 L74,78 L96,64 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="46.2" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Let him stay for Christmas</text></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Edla against her father at the breakfast table</text></svg>
back: Exposed in daylight, the peddler is about to be handed to the sheriff. Edla: she invited him; all year he is chased from place to place; he should have one day of peace. Her father gives in.

title: A rattrap for Christmas
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="The notes come back, with a letter" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="90" y="70" width="140" height="70" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" rx="6"/><rect x="110" y="90" width="60" height="36" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.5" stroke="none"/><text x="140" y="113" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">30 kr</text><g><rect x="190" y="86" width="50" height="34" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none" rx="3"/><path d="M190,86 L215.0,104.7 L240,86 Z" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">The notes come back, with a letter</text></svg>
back: Found after church, when the family has heard of the robbery: a rattrap holding three ten-kronor notes to be returned to the crofter, and a letter thanking Edla for treating him like a captain.

title: How the letter is signed
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="78.3" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">Captain von Stahle</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— a rat who was raised to captain</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: Not because he is a captain but because being treated as one made him behave like one. Dignity given became dignity lived — the story's whole message in a signature.
